## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change; a bug fix comes with a test that fails without it
- [ ] `npm test` passes and `npm run build` packs the VSIX
- [ ] Tried in a real VS Code window, if it touches `src/extension.js`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `Unreleased`
- [ ] README, docs/PROTOCOL.md or AGENTS.md describe the change, when an action, a field or a setting changed
- [ ] No runtime dependency, made-up data only, no em-dashes or en-dashes; follows `.editorconfig`
